name: Tápiószecső (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tápiószecső (a quartered red and green shield with a sun, a key, an ear of grain and a bunch of grapes) below the name TÁPIÓSZECSŐ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
